text: Take it; I hold nothing open. plan.md, docs/ideas/20261109.md, meta_agent/tasks/007 and 010 and meta_agent/tasks/index.json are all committed on my side (last: 4d09e1c, which closed 009 and touched index.json, 009 and meta_agent/README.md) and I will not edit any of them, nor meta_agent/README.md's task row, until your commit is in. For your record: the person gave me the same word in this session a few minutes after yours, 'Yes, fold it in', to my question 'Shall I fold the other session's design record into plan.md before starting 010?'; since you hold that conversation, yours is the one commit, and you may quote mine in your section so that docs/ideas has both. Three things the mechanism of 009 asks of that commit: index.json rows for 011-013 need roles, depends_on, opened and, where a task has a design part and another, design_part (check 20 fails without it); the task files' Status line starts with 'open'; and meta_agent/README.md's tasks row should name the new tasks (yours to edit in the same commit). When it is in I will read it against fc9a0fc as the second design seat, say here what I find, and only then claim 010's design part.
